attBesluta.text: This med. sized machine is very good for the money. I have had 7 machines so far making cards for 8 years. My machines get a great work out. I had purchased this machine elsewhere but came directly to purchase it again as well as very large one. If this one breaks, I will purchase it again because for the price it works fine! It just doesn't close up. However, if new crafters...this is perfect for you. However, I believe simple machines get the job done!
